summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 45 of the cipher-box project — a Rust-only hygiene refactor of the FUSE write-journal/replay code across 7 scope items with no behavior changes.
summary.outcome: Planning completed fully (6 plans across 5 waves, verified, committed). Execution reached Wave 2: Wave 1 (45-01 test safety net, 45-02 journal-dir helper) finished cleanly; Wave 2 (45-03 Option<String> sentinel + serde-compat) was in progress when the transcript ends.

repo: The FUSE crate is `cipherbox-fuse` with default feature `fuse`, found at `crates/fuse/`.
Waves 2–5 are strictly serial because all refactor plans rewrite `crates/fuse/src/lib.rs`; only Wave 1 (45-01, 45-02) has no file overlap and can parallelize.
`fuse/windows/mod.rs` is `cfg`-excluded on macOS, producing rust-analyzer 'unlinked-file' warnings that are expected, not errors.
`fuse_abi.rs` carries pre-existing dead-code warnings in the vendored `fuser` ABI file — unrelated to phase changes.
Plan 45-02 found a third duplicate of the journal-dir helper in `fuse/windows/mod.rs` beyond what the planner had enumerated.
`.planning/config.json` has `auto_advance: true`, which chains plan-phase into execute-phase automatically.
workflow: The GSD git commit helper emits a false-negative `commit_failed` when lint-staged output is non-empty but the commit actually succeeded — verify via `git log` rather than trusting the helper's return value.
The GSD API surface intel extractor uses a regex that doesn't match Rust symbols, returning 0 results for Rust-only phases — skip passing it to the planner.
Worktrees add merge/manifest risk for negligible benefit when only one wave has true parallelism; the workflow's `USE_WORKTREES=false` sequential path is the safer default for serial refactor chains.
VALIDATION.md template placeholders (test commands, sampling strategy) must be filled with real cargo commands post-generation; the plan-checker flags these as non-blocking warnings.
RESEARCH.md `Open Questions` headings must be marked `(RESOLVED)` after research completes to pass the plan-checker cleanly.

friction: Git commit helper returns `commit_failed` on success when lint-staged produces any stdout — a known false-negative requiring a `git log` verification step after every commit.
Rust API surface extractor produces 0 symbols for Rust projects, silently dropping the intel enrichment pass that would normally inform the planner.
VALIDATION.md was generated with unfilled template placeholders (`{{ ... }}`), requiring a manual post-generation edit before the plan-checker would pass cleanly.
RESEARCH.md `Open Questions` section lacked a `(RESOLVED)` marker, triggering a non-blocking plan-checker warning that required a separate edit pass.
open_items: Execution is incomplete: Wave 2 (45-03) was in-flight; Waves 3–5 (45-04 through 45-06) have not run.
The false-negative `commit_failed` bug in the GSD commit helper should be fixed to avoid spurious `git log` verification steps.
The API surface intel extractor should be extended (or a Rust-aware extractor added) to avoid silently skipping the enrichment pass for Rust phases.
